title: Ordinary refund request
message: I signed up for AcmeCloud Pro four days ago and it isn't the right fit. Can I get my money back?

output.response: Yes, that timing works in your favour: AcmeCloud lets you request human review for a refund within 14 days of an initial subscription purchase, and you're within that window. I can't issue refunds myself, so I'm passing this to a colleague who can review it and confirm the outcome with you. It would help if you can tell them the email on the account and roughly when you signed up.
output.escalationReason: Initial-purchase refund within 14 days requires human review.
